services.desc: You can visit our contact page for immediate help as well. We have a full team standing by to answer you calls, e-mails and texts. Sorry about my delay in reports. We only fished a few days this week till the winds blew up on us and it looks like they are here for a while. normal for this time of year I guess though anyways. Capt Joe and Capt Ricky were both able to get offshore... Mahi and sharks are the theme of the week. Actually had more mahi than kings this week. Water out to 220 has been an odd color of black. Black mixed with some brown in it. Almost like Okeechobee cyprus black. Very odd. Hopefully this week of wind blows it out of... What a great week we had. Solid fishing every

quotes.text: Highly recommend! Had a great experience with Fired Up! Starting with snag free booking with Debra's help that included perfect driving and parking directions. Captain Logan made the whole trip perfect. Although we didn't catch any fish that we could keep, we did hook a hammer head shark that was ~6 feet! Our son had it on the line and got it close to the boat for pictures. This is something he will not forget! He got a few smaller catfish that we didn't keep, but we had an awesome time! Logan even stopped the boat so we could see the Space X launch! Highly recommend!read moreread less

Day trip charter 10/10 experience, Debra was super helpful in getting everything set up and ready for us upon arrival, and our charter Captain, Joe was incredible. His knowledge and experience was insightful to us, and even though bites were low for most of the morning, we managed to catch about 9 or 10 fish in total and were able to eat a few pounds of it down the road at Rusty’s restaurant with plenty of leftovers to take home with us. Hopefully we can make this an annual trip for years to come!read moreread less

Best day at sea Logan took Su out for half day and five minutes after our first cast we started catching king makeral and also got a wahoo. We didn't stop catching fish until we headed back to the dock! Awesome day, Logan is the man, and Fired Up is very enjoyable to work with.read moreread less

Nice day on the water Had a great time. Planned a last minute trip, spoke with Chris who was able to accomadate my family of 5. We had captain joe he was great, although the morning started slow, he was able to put us on fish. He was great with kids. We do plan to book again.read moreread less
